name: GBCAMS Sender ESP-NOW (UnitCamS3-5MP)
description: [GBCAMS] ESP-NOW sender firmware for UnitCamS3-5MP. Sends MJPEG frames over ESP-NOW unicast (54Mbps PHY) to Cardputer receiver. Auto-discovery via beacon. ESP-NOW v2.0 large packets: ~25fps capture, 12KB frames in 9 packets (5.8x fewer than v1), ~4-5x lower frame-loss exposure.
author: andjiang

versions.change_log: WiFi STA 启动加 5s 超时重试 (原来无界阻塞: 射频校准失败时固件永久卡在 setup, LED 亮但无流无日志) · 版本串修正 (一直错报 v0.0.7) · 启动打印协议标识 proto 2.0
ESP-NOW v2.0 大包: PKT_DATA_MAX 240→1450B (12KB 帧 52→9 包, 帧丢失暴露面降 ~4-5×) + pacing 200→280µs (> 单包空中时长, 防队列积压). 含 v0.0.7 暗光增强调参 (mega_ccm 真实寄存器链路)

name: GBCAMS Sender AP-HTTP (UnitCamS3-5MP)
description: [GBCAMS] AP-HTTP sender firmware for UnitCamS3-5MP. Same SSID/API as stock firmware (UnitCamS3-WiFi, /api/v1/stream), with camera reset + triple buffering for ~12fps. Use when Cardputer detects the stock-AP path.
author: andjiang

versions.change_log: Stock-AP compatible MJPEG stream with camera reset and triple buffer

name: GBCAMS Receiver (M5Cardputer)
description: Wireless camera viewfinder for M5Cardputer (GBCAMS receiver). Auto-detects CAMS3 firmware: ESP-NOW (blue label, v2.0 large packets) or stock AP-HTTP (yellow label, 12fps). Side-column HUD viewfinder (image 180x135 left + 60px status column), 9 pixel filters (incl. DMG), 4 pixel frames, race-free SD capture, photo gallery (batch delete, favorites, compare, slideshow), bilingual CN/EN help pages (h in both viewfinder and gallery).
author: andjiang
